Reset

Section resets keep unrelated settings. Reset everything removes all saved global and per-weapon choices and restores the default keybinds.

Window sizesRestore the original Builder or Settings window dimensions.
Fresh-install stateVisibility, order, labels, ECO overrides, appearance, layouts and controls are reset.

Gameplay-time options such as Pause, Slow and Real-time remain planned for later runtime validation.

Live previewClick and drag to position
This layout-only preview is shown at 2× magnification inside a 16:9 viewport. Weapon rendering is intentionally limited to the in-game quick menu. Saved position and scale remain exact and are stored separately for each presentation.

Reset everything?

This returns the mod to a fresh-install settings state, including every weapon-specific customization.
